name: Parul Gupta
intro: I work at the intersection of software security and AI, where I study how security weaknesses arise in code and how AI can help find them. Away from the desk, I am usually planning the next trip, looking after my plants or getting back into a good book.
workIntro: I am an AI/ML Security Researcher at CARISSMA, Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt, Germany. My research focuses on software vulnerability analysis, security data quality, architectural security weaknesses and AI-assisted approaches to understanding and evaluating software security.
